# LI.FI catalog fixture

This four-row subset was taken from the real 2026-10-05 `/chains/supported` observation in `docs/evidence/g4-lifi-catalog.json`. Tests use it as mocked HTTP input, not a fresh live catalog. In particular Base has catalog `id: 2`, chain ID `8453`, and type `EVM`. Solana's chain type is `SVM` and its chain identifier is retained as a string.
